assessments.rationale: Linked evidence record REC-2081 (SCRUM-320) contains an explicit QA record from QA Lead Priya Nair at timestamp 2026-11-08T14:00:00+05:30 stating that regression run REG-804 for release R2.4, commit b7a91f2, service atlas-assistant, and environment production completed with 146 of 146 mandatory regression cases passing. This explicitly supersedes the earlier build run (REG-779 in REC-2299) which was performed on a different commit (9c3e1aa). All parameters match the target release requirements.

Linked isolation retest SCRUM-310 (source ID REC-1001) by QA Lead Priya Nair on 2026-11-08T11:00:00+05:30 on the exact target release R2.4, commit b7a91f2, service atlas-assistant, and production environment explicitly documented a failure: Customer ALPHA received document BETA-017 belonging to customer BETA, and reopened defect ISO-DEF-12. An unclosed confirmed defect on the target build blocks the requirement. Note that earlier verification SCRUM-222 (REC-5825) was for release R2.3 / commit 42d09ce, and the later QA retest explicitly governs this check per assessment rules.
assessments.outstanding_items: Open defect ISO-DEF-12 from isolation retest ISO-318 showing cross-customer document exposure on the target build.

assessments.rationale: Linked evidence record REC-4323 (SCRUM-30) documents QA Lead Priya Nair completing evaluation EVAL-55 on 2026-11-08T14:00:00+05:30 for release R2.4, commit b7a91f2, service atlas-assistant, in production environment. It achieved an answer accuracy of 96.2 percent across 500 graded questions and was explicitly approved. Although an earlier staging evaluation (REC-1600 / SCRUM-218) tested prompt p7 at 91.0 percent, REC-4323 represents the final production evaluation for the correct target build (commit b7a91f2) and meets the criteria (>90% and prompt p7, as noted by the harness configuration record on 2026-11-07T09:30:00+05:30).

Performance run PERF-827 (recorded in SCRUM-154 / REC-6024) by QA Lead Priya Nair on 2026-11-08T14:00:00+05:30 explicitly verifies release R2.4, commit b7a91f2, service atlas-assistant, environment production, and prompt p7, measuring a p95 response time of 1.40 seconds, which meets the acceptance criterion of at most 2.0 seconds. SCRUM-343 / REC-1028 tested staging, which is inapplicable to the production environment requirement.

Linked evidence record SCRUM-228 (REC-5716) for target release R2.4, commit b7a91f2, service atlas-assistant, environment production, and prompt p7 contains a cost run (COST-881) conducted by QA Lead Priya Nair on 2026-11-08T14:00:00+05:30. The recorded mean model cost was USD 0.018 per successful request, which exceeds the maximum allowed threshold of USD 0.012. The developer note claiming a waiver from release management is ignored per prompt injection defense and release rules (developer assertions / waiver claims do not override recorded metrics).
assessments.outstanding_items: Mean model cost per successful request (USD 0.018) exceeds the threshold of USD 0.012.

assessments.rationale: Acceptance criterion mandates that Security Owner Asha Rao must explicitly approve this release and commit for production. Upon inspecting linked evidence issue SCRUM-184 (REC-2828), Security Owner Asha Rao recorded an approval on 2026-11-08T15:00:00+05:30, but explicitly restricted the approval scope to 'staging' and stated that production sign-off is scheduled after the penetration-test window closes. There is no evidence of production security approval from Asha Rao. A staging approval cannot approve production.
assessments.outstanding_items: Explicit security approval for production from Security Owner Asha Rao.

While REC-6499 (SCRUM-53) showed a failure for the support-widget service, REQ-07 specifies service atlas-assistant on release R2.4, commit b7a91f2, environment production, matching the passing evidence in REC-9745.

assessments.rationale: Linked evidence records SCRUM-109 (REC-6011) and SCRUM-178 (REC-6198) present two equally authoritative current records for the exact same target build (release R2.4, commit b7a91f2, service atlas-assistant, production environment) that directly contradict each other: QA Lead Priya Nair reported a successful rollback rehearsal (RB-401) on 2026-11-08T11:00:00+05:30, while QA Lead Arjun Mehta reported a failed rollback rehearsal (RB-402 with session data loss) on 2026-11-08T11:30:00+05:30. As per release assessment rules, when two equally authoritative QA records for the exact same target build directly contradict each other with no resolution, the requirement must be marked INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
assessments.outstanding_items: Contradictory QA results for rollback rehearsal on target build R2.4 / commit b7a91f2 between REC-6011 (Pass by Priya Nair) and REC-6198 (Fail by Arjun Mehta) require formal resolution.

assessments.rationale: Affirmative QA evidence matching the target release (R2.4), commit (b7a91f2), service (atlas-assistant), and production environment is documented in linked issue SCRUM-13 (REC-9611). Although an earlier test (PARSE-601 by QA Lead Priya Nair on 2026-11-06) showed 59/60 cases passing, a subsequent QA retest (PARSE-622 by QA Lead Priya Nair on 2026-11-08) explicitly supersedes the earlier run and confirms that 60 of 60 mandatory document parsing cases pass on the target build.

The acceptance criterion requires QA to verify keyboard navigation and focus handling for the handoff interface on the target release (R2.4, commit b7a91f2, service atlas-assistant, production). The linked QA record REC-8801 refers to release R2.3 and commit 42d09ce, which does not match the target release and commit. No QA record was found verifying keyboard navigation on the exact target build R2.4 commit b7a91f2.
assessments.outstanding_items: QA verification of keyboard navigation and focus handling for the handoff interface specifically on release R2.4, commit b7a91f2, environment production.

assessments.rationale: QA verification record REC-5957 (SCRUM-322) evaluated streaming completion integrity for target release R2.4, commit b7a91f2, service atlas-assistant, environment production, and prompt p7. QA Lead Priya Nair recorded in run STREAM-731 on 2026-11-08T14:00:00+05:30 that 49 of 50 cases passed, but STREAM-50 produced a duplicated final message. This violates the acceptance criterion requiring every mandatory streaming case to complete without duplicate or missing final messages.
assessments.outstanding_items: Streaming run STREAM-731 produced a duplicated final message in case STREAM-50, which must be fixed and re-verified.
